name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Switch between sibling views inside the same destination. Three chrome variants — pill (sunken track + raised thumb, Apple-flavor), underline (linear sub-nav, Linear-flavor), enclosed (bordered panel, admin-flavor). Distinct from Segmented (single-choice control inside a form row) and from Navbar tabs (top-level nav). One thumb visible at a time. Tab content lives in `<TabsPanel>` siblings with matching `value`.
